limitations: Exact mixed moment only for unit regular tetrahedra (with scale covariance); elliptic rather than elementary form; historical equivalences may remain undiscovered.
scientific_integrity: The mixed moment and negative correlation were previously reported numerically; the present mathematical contribution is an exact elliptic evaluation and rigorous sign certificate. No independent external audit has been performed.
title: Exact elliptic mixed shadow moment and negative covariance of a regular tetrahedron
